messages:
Noah: Kettlebell + slab sprint mini-challenge? 2-week run starting Monday. 3 categories: KB swings, stair sprints, and lunchtime slab boulder. small prize = homemade granola jar. interested?

Jessie: Count me in! What's the movement standard for KB swings?

Coach Amy: Keep it simple — baseline Rx: 16kg for women, 24kg for men. Scale as needed. Form check session Wednesday 12:30 on the rooftop.

Devon: I only have a 12kg but I can scale. For stairs, is it full sprint up or up-and-down x3?

Mike: Up-and-down x3 for time sounds fair. I'll make a quick Strava segment.

Rachel: I'll run the scoreboard. Google Sheet? Also can we add a mobility mini-challenge (ankle drills) to avoid injuries :sweat_smile:?

Noah: Good call. I'll post a sign-up poll — react to pick your main category: :one: KB swings, :two: Stairs, :three: Boulder.

StravaBot: New Strava route created: https://strava.app.link/KB-StairSprint-Redwood

Jessie: Who's bringing a crashpad for the slab at lunch? I can pack one if needed.

Devon: I can spot and bring tape. Chalk is in the equipment closet FYI.

Coach Amy: Also please fill this quick entry form so we can seed the leaderboard: `https://forms.gle/abcd1234` — just name, category, and any scaling notes. Fill by Sunday night.

Mike: For the swings, try `5x5 swing` as a micro-protocol to build strength between sessions. Warmup first.

Rachel: Leaderboard starter: Mike 0, Noah 0, Jessie 0 :laughing: (we're all equal until Monday)

Noah: :thumbsup: I'll DM the granola prize logistics. Need two folks to judge lunchtime boulder attempts — volunteers?

Jessie: Me.

Devon: Me too.

Coach Amy: Love the energy — thank you! Slack reminder?

Noah: Yes please @channel — remind Monday 11:45am so folks can warm up.

ReminderBot: Reminder scheduled for Mon 11:45am.
